plan: [This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction: the winner pays the highest other bid. Bidding my true valuation is a dominant strategy and maximizes expected profit regardless of others. I will bid my private value $27. Ties are random and don't change optimality.]

[This is a second-price (highest other bid sets the price) sealed-bid auction with independent private values. In such auctions, truthful bidding is a dominant strategy. There is no history to learn from in this single round. Ties are random but bidding my true value maximizes expected profit (win whenever price < value, pay that price). Therefore I will bid my private value of $31. ]
